fullContentHtml:

UPSSSC VPO Result 2026: The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the final result of the Gram Panchayat Adhikari Main Examination or Village Panchayat Officer (VPO) on upsssc.gov.in. A total of 1468 candidates have been selected for the post of Gram Panchayat Adhikari under the Panchayati Raj Department of the state. The commission has also uploaded the category-wise list of selected candidates and the final cut-off marks along with the result

UPSSSC VPO Result PDF 2026

The direct link to download the PDF is given below. Candidates can check the list of category-wise roll numbers of the finally selected candidates and other important instructions through the provided PDF.

UPSSSC VPO Final Result 2026: Click to Download

UPSSSC Gram Panchayat Adhikari Result 2026 Overview

More details related to the result have been given in the table below:

Particulars Details
Exam Conducting Authority Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
Post Name Gram Panchayat Adhikari
Department Panchayati Raj Department, Uttar Pradesh
Total Vacancies 1468
Selected Candidates 1468
Provisionally Included Candidates 96
Official Website upsssc.gov.in

Download Here UPSSSC Gram Panchayat Adhikari Previous Year Paper

How to Check UPSSSC VPO Result 2026?

Candidates can follow these steps to check the Gram Panchayat Adhikari result or selection list:

Step 1: Visit the official UPSSSC website upsssc.gov.in

Step 2: Click on ‘विज्ञापन संख्या-01-परीक्षा/2023, ग्राम पंचायत अधिकारी मुख्य परीक्षा(प्रा०अ०प०-2022)/01 का अंतिम चयन परिणाम ।’

Step 3: Download the UP VPO Final Result PDF.

Step 4: Search for your roll number in the PDF.

Step 5: Save the result PDF for future reference.

Download Here UP Gram Panchayat Adhikari Syllabus

UPSSSC VPO Cut Off 2026

Along with the final result, UPSSSC has released the cut-off details for the selected candidates. The cut-off is given in terms of the marks obtained by the last selected candidate in each category.

Category-Wise Cut Off Marks

Category Marks of Last Selected Candidate Date of Birth of Last Selected Candidate
Unreserved 68.25 08 July 1991
Scheduled Caste 57.75 10 March 2002
Scheduled Tribe 54.50 24 December 1999
Other Backward Classes 68.25 08 May 1992
Economically Weaker Sections 65.75 28 October 1992

Horizontal Reservation Cut Off

The Commission has also provided separate details for candidates selected under horizontal reservation categories.

Category Marks of Last Selected Candidate Date of Birth of Last Selected Candidate
Dependants of Freedom Fighters 60.00 24 March 1994
PwD – LV 57.00 16 July 1997
PwD – HH 48.00 26 July 1992
Women 60.25 31 July 2002
Ex-Servicemen 55.50 07 April 1986
Outstanding Sportspersons No candidate available –

UPSSSC VPO Result 2026 FAQs

Ques: When was the UPSSSC Gram Panchayat Adhikari result released?

Answer: The final result was released on August 17, 2026.

Ques: How many candidates have been selected?

Answer: A total of 1,468 candidates have been selected for the Gram Panchayat Adhikari post.

Ques: When was the written examination held?

Answer: The Gram Panchayat Adhikari Main Examination was conducted on 27 April 2025.

Ques: What is the UPSSSC VPO unreserved category cut-off?

Answer: The final cut-off for the unreserved category is 68.25 marks.
